title: New law: A bill affecting the representation of the majority and minority membership of the Senate Members of the Joint Economic Committee. (Public Law 107-3)
summary: S. 279 of the 107th Congress became Public Law 107-3 on 2001-03-13.

title: New law: To designate the United States courthouse located at 1 Courthouse Way in Boston, Massachusetts, as the "John Joseph Moakley United States Courthouse". (Public Law 107-2)
summary: H.R. 559 of the 107th Congress became Public Law 107-2 on 2001-03-13.

summary: S.J.Res. 6 of the 107th Congress became Public Law 107-5 on 2001-03-20.

summary: H.J.Res. 19 of the 107th Congress became Public Law 107-4 on 2001-03-16.
